description: This file defines the Interval and IntervalSet classes used in the ANTLR project for managing collections of intervals, including methods for creating, manipulating, and string representation of interval sets.

classes.name: Interval
classes.description: Represents a range with start and stop positions.

classes.name: IntervalSet
classes.description: Represents a collection of Intervals with methods for set operations.

methods.name: NewInterval
methods.description: Creates a new Interval with specified start and stop.

methods.name: NewIntervalSet
methods.description: Creates a new, empty, writable IntervalSet.

methods.name: Contains
methods.description: Checks if an item is within the interval.

methods.name: String
methods.description: Returns a string representation of the interval.

methods.name: Length
methods.description: Returns the length of the interval.

methods.name: Equals
methods.description: Checks if two IntervalSets are equal.

methods.name: first
methods.description: Returns the start of the first interval or TokenInvalidType if empty.

methods.name: addOne
methods.description: Adds a single value as an interval.

methods.name: addRange
methods.description: Adds a range of values as an interval.

methods.name: addInterval
methods.description: Adds an Interval to the set.

methods.name: addSet
methods.description: Adds all intervals from another IntervalSet.

methods.name: complement
methods.description: Returns the complement of the set within a range.

methods.name: contains
methods.description: Checks if an item is contained in the set.

methods.name: length
methods.description: Returns total number of elements in the set.

methods.name: removeRange
methods.description: Removes a range of intervals.

methods.name: removeOne
methods.description: Removes a single element from the set.

methods.name: StringVerbose
methods.description: Returns a verbose string representation of the set.

methods.name: GetIntervals
methods.description: Returns the list of intervals.

methods.name: toCharString
methods.description: Returns a string with character representations.

methods.name: toIndexString
methods.description: Returns a string with index representations.

methods.name: toTokenString
methods.description: Returns a string with token names.

methods.name: elementName
methods.description: Returns the name of an element based on literal and symbolic names.
